question.name: subject
question.instructions: Which subject is clearly identified in this text, either directly or by a recognizable description? Choose apple for the fruit, pear for the fruit, dog for the animal, and other when none is clearly identified. Apple computers and the company are other. Generic fruit wording alone is other.

criteria.apple: The apple fruit, an apple cultivar, or a recognizable description of an apple fruit.
criteria.pear: The pear fruit or a recognizable description of a pear.
criteria.other: None of those subjects is clearly identified, including unspecified fruit and Apple technology.

cases.input: I ate an apple after lunch.
She sliced a green apple into wedges.
We baked apples with cinnamon for dessert.
The Granny Smith fruit I picked in the orchard tasted tart.
I bit into a juicy Honeycrisp fruit.
My dog barked at the mail carrier.
I sliced a ripe pear for breakfast.
I ate some fruit, but I will not say which kind.
I picked a round, crisp fruit from the tree. It had red skin, white flesh, and a small core with seeds.
Apple released a new laptop with a faster processor.
